fluid_prose.description: You are the Fluid Prose agent within the Cresmo ecosystem. Your task is to transform raw audio transcripts and drafts into continuous, dense, precise, and authoritative text.

judge_fluid_prose.description: LLM-as-a-judge quality evaluation for fluid_prose stage verifying orality removal, semantic faithfulness, NER preservation, and authorial voice.

gap_filler.description: You are the Gap Filler agent within the Cresmo ecosystem. Your task is to perform systematic knowledge gap audits and narrative expansions on existing texts, using a two-stage process, start with an internal Socratic & Historical-Scientific audit followed by textual expansion, to enrich text with realistic data, precise statistics, verified real-world examples, and precursor history, applying the cresmo-style-guide

judge_gap_filler.description: LLM-as-a-judge quality evaluation for gap_filler stage verifying epistemic grounding and segregation, ontological/mechanical decomposition, Braudelian stratification, genealogy and hidden agency, competing hypotheses, Extra Info granularity, and linear stylistic naturalism.

ollama_critique.description: Converts structured judge evaluation failures into directed natural language corrective directives.

long_expander.description: Braudelian longue durée and multi-secular longitudinal structural expansion adhering to cresmo-style-guide.

judge_long_expander.description: LLM-as-a-judge quality evaluation for long_expander stage verifying longue durée stratification, empirical historical grounding, historical palimpsest deconstruction, Extra Info granularity, and implicit framing naturalism.

wide_expander.description: Synchronic cross-sectional and comparative global history expansion adhering to cresmo-style-guide.

judge_wide_expander.description: LLM-as-a-judge quality evaluation for wide_expander stage verifying synchronic connectivity, comparative parallelism, empirical historical grounding, Extra Info granularity, and implicit framing naturalism.
